whenToUse: Read only star scores at 3 sizes, with partial stars for averages such as 3.5 or 4.6
Star inputs that collect a whole star score in feedback and written review forms
Review summaries with a count bar per star level, and 5 step emoji scales for quick feedback

whenNotToUse.when: A full product page section of buyer quotes, avatars and a ratings overview
A required score that keyboard and screen reader users must be able to set
A score picked in half or finer steps rather than whole stars

agentNotes: An `editable` `Rating` takes pointer clicks only: each star is a `div` with an `onClick` and no role, tab stop or key handler
Clicks send whole numbers from 1 to `maxRating` to `onRatingChange`; a decimal `rating` draws a partial star but cannot be picked
`starClassName` styles the `showValue` number, not the stars; recolor stars from `className` through the `rating-star-filled` slot
